A sibling test in the same folder records a failing gate, so the two results should be compared before relying on either.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup
sections.what: Imports the hashing and file tools, the test tools, and the slope test, Brier and sample functions.
sections.why: Gives the tests the functions they need to reproduce the saved result.

sections.name: Row, flat
sections.title: Walk-forward row shape and loader
sections.what: Describes one scored match row, with its date, outcome, adjustment and three prediction lists. Loads the saved file and turns the rows into flat samples for each prediction method.
sections.why: The pooled checks need every match scored by the same method in one list.
sections.watch_out: Row field names must match the saved file exactly.

sections.name: walk-forward calibration gate on real seasons (calibration)
sections.title: Walk-forward pass checks
sections.what: Checks the file hash. Checks that tuning used 2023 and 2024 and chose the update rate with the lowest Brier score. Checks that matches on the same date share one adjustment. Checks that the pooled slope test and Brier scores reproduce. Checks that all four D-030 checks pass and that the simulation and minimum detectable shift meet their limits.
sections.why: Likely reason: confirms the saved claim of a pass, and that no match was scored with later information.
sections.watch_out: The simulation pass rate and the minimum detectable shift are hard limits. Loosening them would let a weaker model pass.

summary: Checks a saved walk-forward calibration result, where each match is scored only with information from earlier dates, and confirms the recorded pass.
purpose: Checks that the walk-forward calibration (decision D-030) does not use future information and that its pooled verdict can be reproduced.
why: The comments say this is the owner's D-030 gate run on Cricsheet IPL data. The test protects the claim that it passed.
how: Loads calibration-v3.json, checks its hash, checks that tuning used 2023 and 2024, checks the date ordering and the same-day rule, recalculates the pooled slope test and Brier scores, and checks the four D-030 checks and the simulation results.
risks: The pass depends on stored seeds and bootstrap counts. If those change, the saved numbers and the recomputed numbers can drift apart.
debug: Compare the recomputed pooled Wald value and Brier scores with the stored values. If the same-day check fails, check the date sorting of the rows.
